analysis.summary: Srivari Spices and Foods Limited reported financial and operational results for H1 FY26, highlighting revenue from operations of Rs. 7,877.37 lakhs and an EBITDA margin of 17.05%. The company detailed its supply chain operations, manufacturing capacities across spices, atta, and oil, and various brand awards received in 2025. Management also outlined portfolio expansions including the launch of a new oil plant, Soya Chunks, and a new puja devotional articles vertical named 'Neihaa Narayan'.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 to 2029.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 –2029, driven by rising health awareness and higher protein consumption.

demand_outlook.claim: Over 70% of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake as cited from the Indian Market Research Bureau.
demand_outlook.quote: Over 70% of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake (Source: Indian Market Research Bureau).

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai on 28 July 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra on 28 July 2025 .

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin for H1 FY26 stood at 17.05%.
